deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit enables `extract_hidden_states` speculative decoding on Model Runner V2 upstream. vllm-ascend's V2 runner (NPUModelRunner, extends GPUModelRunner) calls super().__init__(), which now transiently constructs the upstream ExtractHiddenStatesSpeculator and sets use_aux_hidden_state_outputs=True for this method; then it deletes self.speculator and re-initializes via vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py::init_speculator, which raises NotImplementedError for extract_hidden_states. To support the feature on NPU: (1) add an `extract_hidden_states` branch in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py returning a new AscendExtractHiddenStatesSpeculator; (2) create vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/extract_hidden_states/speculator.py subclassing the new upstream ExtractHiddenStatesSpeculator, following the existing eagle/dflash/dspark speculator pattern, adapting propose()'s set_forward_context + self.model(hidden_states=...) execution for NPU (note init_cudagraph_manager/capture are no-ops, so no ACL/CUDA graph manager needed; update_stream assignment in NPUModelRunner.__init__ is harmless but irrelevant); (3) ensure aux_hidden_states capture from the target model flows through NPUModelRunner.execute_model (already implemented at vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:247-259); (4) verify the draft model (ExtractHiddenStatesModel/CacheOnlyAttentionLayer, vllm/model_executor/models/extract_hidden_states.py) loads and runs on NPU with the Ascend attention backend, reusing knowledge from the existing V1 adaptation (AscendExtractHiddenStatesProposer in vllm_ascend/spec_decode/extract_hidden_states_proposer.py). Also consider whether use_aux_hidden_state_outputs needs explicit handling in NPUModelRunner since upstream now sets it for extract_hidden_states.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium-low. Purely additive feature; no existing vllm-ascend functionality is broken (unsupported method still fails fast via NotImplementedError in the V2 init_speculator). Main risks: (1) during NPUModelRunner super().__init__(), the upstream ExtractHiddenStatesSpeculator allocates a torch.zeros hidden_states buffer on the NPU device and validates draft config (eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids, num_speculative_steps==1) before being deleted/replaced - config errors surface as clear exceptions, not hangs; (2) NPU correctness of the cache-only attention model execution and aux-hidden-state capture in the V2 path must be validated, since only the V1 path has been tested on NPU so far.

commits.message:
Fix weight tying (#51665)

Signed-off-by: Harry Mellor <19981378+hmellor@users.noreply.github.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/xlite/xlite.py: StandardXliteModel._build_model (line 339, reads hf_config.tie_word_embeddings to pick head = embed vs lm_head.weight)

vllm_ascend/model_loader/netloader/netloader.py and vllm_ascend/model_loader/rfork/rfork_loader.py (use load_format='auto', so new ModelConfig.maybe_untie_word_embeddings + checkpoint_has_lm_head metadata read runs; they also rebind process_weights_after_loading)

vllm_ascend custom models inheriting upstream model classes without lm_head skip (deepseek_v4/model.py, minimax_m3, qwen3_dspark.py, llama_eagle3*.py) - behavior changed by removal of skip_prefixes=['lm_head.']
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
Commit f0c14b4f776b reworks word-embedding tying: ModelConfig.maybe_untie_word_embeddings() (invoked in VllmConfig.__post_init__) flips tie_word_embeddings=False whenever the checkpoint ships its own lm_head.weight (new checkpoint_has_lm_head in vllm/transformers_utils/config.py, safetensors-metadata based), models now always load lm_head (skip_prefixes removed across ~60 model files), and the new vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_tying.py::maybe_retie_word_embeddings() is called at the start of process_weights_after_loading to re-tie an identical lm_head and reclaim memory.

1) REQUIRED: vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_process_weights_after_loading.py replaces the upstream process_weights_after_loading wholesale and does NOT call maybe_retie_word_embeddings. Because of this, on Ascend the re-tie never runs: for any tied-embedding checkpoint that ships a redundant lm_head (the exact scenario this fix targets, common with quantization/fine-tuning tooling), the model is built untied and the full duplicate lm_head weight is loaded and retained -> silent memory regression (potentially several GB on large-vocab models like DeepSeek V4 / MiniMax M3). Add `from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_tying import maybe_retie_word_embeddings` and call it as the first step of ascend_process_weights_after_loading (before the quant-method loop), mirroring upstream. Note: _get_untied_lm_head only matches UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod; AscendUnquantizedEmbeddingMethod310 (vllm_ascend/_310p/ops/vocab_parallel_embedding.py) subclasses it so unquantized heads are handled, while quantized heads (modelopt_mxfp8, modelslim, etc.) are correctly skipped. Also watch the NPU->CPU syncs in maybe_retie_word_embeddings (torch.equal on .cpu() tensors); acceptable at load time but evaluate.

2) REVIEW: vllm_ascend/xlite/xlite.py:339 branches on hf_config.tie_word_embeddings. maybe_untie_word_embeddings now mutates the (text) config to False for checkpoints that ship lm_head, so xlite will select lm_head.weight (get_dotted_attr ... raises=True) instead of embed. Since Ascend does not re-tie (item 1), lm_head.weight exists and this is consistent, but if item 1's re-tie is added, the lm_head attribute is replaced by the embeddings module (tie_weights) and the xlite head resolution must still find a weight. Validate for all xlite-supported architectures (Llama/Qwen2/Qwen3/Qwen3VL/GLM4/DeepSeekV3/V3.2/MiniMax M2).

3) VERIFY: VllmConfig.__post_init__ now runs maybe_untie_word_embeddings for netloader/rfork (load_format 'auto' is not in the skip list 'dummy'/'sharded_state'/'runai_streamer_sharded'), adding a safetensors-metadata read (and possible network fetch) during config init on NPU; checkpoint_has_lm_head returns None for non-safetensors checkpoints and the untie is then skipped (no crash). Confirm ascend's loaders and custom models (deepseek_v4, minimax_m3, qwen3_dspark, llama_eagle3) still load correctly with the new always-load-lm_head behavior and that no ascend path reads the new word_embeddings_untied_by_checkpoint flag.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. Without adaptation, Ascend silently diverges from upstream: duplicate tied lm_head weights are retained (memory regression, output correctness unaffected since the standalone head is loaded and equal), and the config tie_word_embeddings flip plus the new safetensors-metadata read add untested behavior in Ascend loaders/xlite. With adaptation, care is required around NPU tensor comparisons (.cpu()/torch.equal syncs), quantized-lm_head handling with Ascend-specific embedding quant methods, and xlite head resolution after a re-tie.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
该 commit 是纯增量特性（默认关闭、向后兼容），不破坏 vllm-ascend 现有功能：ModelConfig/VllmConfig/EngineArgs/SamplingParams/InputProcessor 全部是带默认值的新增字段与校验，GPUModelRunner 仅多传一个默认 False 的 enable_trace_replay 给 Sampler，Sampler 仅在该开关为 True 时才创建 TraceReplayState。因此 vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunnerV2（继承 GPUModelRunner.__init__ 并复用 vLLM 的 V2 Sampler）无需改动即可编译运行。但要在 NPU 上真正启用 trace replay，需要做以下低工作量适配：
1. 验证 vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/trace_replay.py 中新增的 Triton 内核 _trace_replay_kernel 在 triton-ascend 上可编译运行（内核极简单：tl.load/tl.store/tl.program_id + int64 转换，大概率直接可用）；若 triton-ascend 不支持，则在 vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py 中仿照 apply_top_k_top_p_triton/gumbel_sample 等已有做法，用 vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/ 下的 NPU 实现覆盖 apply_trace_tokens（例如 torch 索引替换或 npu 自定义 op）。
2. 确认 TraceReplayState 的大缓冲区 (max_num_reqs, max_model_len) int32 StagedWriteTensor(uva_instead_of_gpu=True) 与 UvaBackedTensor 在 patch_uva.py 的 UvaBufferWrapper 回退路径（PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF 未设 pinned_mem_register:True 时的 dirty-row copy）下正常工作，并评估长上下文下的内存占用；该模式与已有 bad_words/logprob/states 一致，风险小。
3. 补充 NPU 侧测试：在 vllm-ascend tests/ 下镜像 vllm 的 tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_trace_replay.py、tests/v1/sample/test_trace_replay_params.py，验证 NPU 上强制 token 与真实 logprob 的正确性。
4. 注意 trace replay 被 vLLM 门控在 V2 model runner（VllmConfig._verify_trace_replay_config 对 V1 抛错），因此 vllm-ascend 的 V1 路径（vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py 与 AscendSampler）不受影响，无需改动；仅需在文档/平台校验中说明该特性需 use_v2_model_runner=True。
deep_analysis.risk: 低。特性默认关闭且纯增量，不影响任何现有 NPU 工作负载；仅在启用 --enable-trace-replay 时才有风险：新 Triton 内核在 triton-ascend 上编译失败（需 NPU 回退实现）、UVA 回退路径的同步开销或超大缓冲分配、以及 apply_trace 在 logprob 计算前覆盖 sampled token 的时序若被 vllm-ascend 自定义采样流破坏会导致错误 logprob。由于内核简单且复用已有 UVA 模式，适配工作量小、整体风险低。
